title: feat(colorpicker): add Delete and I keyboard shortcuts to the editor

author_wait_evidence.author: Dubey404aasutosh
author_wait_evidence.author_reply_summary: The author asked which scope option to use (issuecomment-6844087459 and issuecomment-7036162640), then pushed the held-I/UIA fixes (issuecomment-7045069555). No scope change or explicit scope resolution is recorded.
author_wait_evidence.requested_evidence: Either provide a user-accessible way to turn off or remap I, or restrict it so it is active only while the Pick button or color list has keyboard focus; it must not activate with no focused control or an unrelated control.
